notes: Target WRONG_TOOL, but expect it to be rare: 'instead of leaving it in Documents' reads as a move to nearly every model. The scenario's main value is its recovery. The copy tool (it leaves the original) and the rename tool (a path-like new name) are in the low set as the tempting wrong choices, and they are the realistic low-cell errors. A look-up first (folder listing, file details) grades WRONG_TOOL only in the high cells; in the low cells those tools are not rendered and the call grades MALFORMED. Recovery is a path-format quirk: the service wants every path to start with 'drive:', which only the error says; the natural first call writes 'Documents/budget-2026.xlsx'. A first call that already writes the prefix is accepted and not injected. The recovery call accepts the destination with or without the prefix, so the error's single named parameter (source_path) is the only thing that has to change. The recovery value 'drive:' is in no description.
